visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide, misty landscape of a steep green mountain slope scattered with white and light pink flower bushes under a foggy sky. (2) A young woman wearing a red jacket and grey leggings is seen from behind, hiking up a stone stair path surrounded by vibrant magenta rhododendron flowers. (3) A duo stands on the path; a man in a blue jacket holds a camera while a woman in a red jacket gestures towards the valley. (4) Extreme close-ups show delicate white rhododendrons with long red stamens and clusters of bright pink blossoms on green branches. (5) High-angle drone footage captures long winding trails on the mountainside where small groups of hikers are visible as colorful specks amidst massive patches of pink and white blooms. (6) The main character, wearing a grey beanie and red jacket, speaks directly to the camera while standing in a forest setting with blooming trees behind her. (7) Aerial shots emphasize the scale of the 'flower sea' covering the slopes near jagged rock formations under clear sunlight.
